_README: City fit record - method UNIFORM-RESIZE ONLY (pass 1, per owner instruction: resize, not cut, not squash).
Each delivered piece is a positioned layer at 1920x1080 = 1.5x canvas. Every piece is resized by ONE uniform
downscale x0.6667 (1920x1080 -> 1280x720). No crop, no per-compartment scale, no non-uniform transform, no cut.
Pieces composite at canvas origin (they are positioned layers, so x2/3 places each UI group at its canvas coords).
cavity = measured dark-leather interior at canvas coords (lum<40, opaque alpha). anchor = game rect from ../anchors.json.
delta = cavity - anchor (x, y, w, h). Positive/negative deltas show where the delivered art's internal layout
differs from the game's anchors; under pure resize these are NOT forced to zero. Units flagged below need the
owner's decision (accept offset, or permit per-compartment placement - translation only - to fix).
The card bezel (bezzel_card_city.png, owner-provided transparent art, WORKFLOW trap 17) is documented below and
passed through at port time - it is NOT resized here and NOT a placed strip.
transform: resize x0.6667 uniform only; no crop; no per-compartment scale; no non-uniform transform
misaligned_vs_anchor_under_pure_resize: pause: cavity y366 vs anchor y560 (dy -194) - right column's pause sits ~194px above the game's pause button
restart: cavity y402 vs anchor y610 (dy -208) - same, ~208px above
status: cavity y539 vs anchor y494, cavity 664x93 vs anchor 670x88 - plaque is wider than the score strip
stock_frame: cavity 114x182 vs anchor 76x124 - delivered stock frame is much larger than the game's stock rect
right column internal vertical spacing (rnd/combos/pause/restart) does not match the game's y anchors
lanes sit ~5-8px left of anchor x=12 and ~6-25px below anchor y (irregular pitch vs game's 41.4)
owner_decision_needed: Pure resize leaves pause/restart/status/stock (and right-column vertical layout) misaligned vs game anchors. Under pure resize a live round would draw frames offset from hitboxes. Owner must decide: accept the offsets as-is, or permit per-compartment placement (translation only, no crop, no squash) to align cavities to anchors.
